entities.name: Bartek
entities.description: A young day laborer and former thug in Ravnica's market district who is sweet on Andra and buys her a gift.

entities.name: Andra
entities.description: A beautiful, friendly stall keeper on Bane Alley who is secretly a House Dimir agent.

entities.name: Boss Zifka
entities.description: A merchant who employs Bartek to load crates, some of which are mislabeled, and pays him quietly.

entities.name: Nico
entities.description: A thieving boy who treats Bartek as a friend and warns him that Andra is only after his money.

entities.name: Imrich
entities.description: A weasel-eyed jewelry merchant on Tin Street who haggles with Bartek over the ornament.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: A Ravnican guild of secrets, for which Andra sells an illicit dagger and reports in coded messages.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The Boros recruiter on Tin Street offers coin to strong young men to join the Wojeks, the city's lawkeepers.

entities.name: Tin Street
entities.description: A bright market street where hawkers sell wares and Imrich keeps a jewelry stall.

entities.name: Bane Alley
entities.description: A quiet alley near Bartek's home where Andra's stall is tucked away.

entities.name: Black Dagger
entities.description: An exquisite dark curved dagger Andra sells Bartek for five zinos; it is later stolen back by the real buyers.

events.summary: Bartek finishes loading Boss Zifka's cart and is paid a zino, keeping quiet about mismatched crates.
events.quote: Bartek was good at staying quiet.

events.summary: Bartek haggles with Imrich on Tin Street and buys a pewter ornament for eighty zibs.
Nico warns Bartek that Andra is only after his money, and Bartek shoves him aside.
Bartek gives Andra the ornament as a gift, and she hooks it to her headband.
events.quote: She brushed her hair aside, found an empty spot on her headband, and hooked the ornament to it.

events.summary: Andra sells Bartek the dark dagger for five zinos, leaving him with one zino.
events.quote: “Deal,” he said. “Five zinos. I’ll be broke, but I’ll look good doing it.”

events.summary: The next morning Bartek arrives bruised, having been jumped on his way to work and robbed of the dagger.
events.quote: Couple of guys jumped me last night on my way to work.

events.summary: Andra writes a coded report: the item is now with a third party, revealing she works for House Dimir and sold the dagger twice.
events.quote: All she knew was that the House Dimir wanted it sold to someone in particular, and they didn’t want any link between its new owners and her.

events.summary: Andra explains her trick of selling an illicit item then arranging for it to be stolen, and that she asked the buyer to leave Bartek alive.
events.quote: She’d been relieved to see Bartek’s face, even banged up as it was.

relations.note: She reports to superiors in coded messages for the guild.
relations.quote: All she knew was that the House Dimir wanted it sold to someone in particular, and they didn’t want any link between its new owners and her.

relations.note: Bartek loads crates for the merchant Zifka.
relations.quote: Bartek had been loading for Zifka for a long time, and he knew what the merchant wanted.

relations.note: Bartek is sweet on Andra, who sees him as a nice kid.
relations.quote: “You’re really sweet on her, aren’t you?” said Nico.
